name: Wrathful Smite
casting_time: 1 bonus action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
description: The triggering hit deals an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage. The target makes a Wisdom save and is Frightened for the duration on a failure, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. **Higher-Level Slots.** Extra damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1.
